name: Get Zip Code Weather Forecast Snapshot
description: Looks up the weather.gov (or similar) local forecast for a given US ZIP code and reads back the current temperature (°F), and tonight's forecast text. Use when an agent needs a quick current-conditions and overnight outlook snapshot for a specific ZIP code.

inputs.name: zipCode
inputs.description: US ZIP code to search for in the local forecast lookup box

outputs.name: currentTemperatureF
outputs.description: The current temperature reading in Fahrenheit shown in the Current Conditions section

outputs.name: tonightForecastText
outputs.description: The full text of tonight's forecast entry from the 7-day forecast panel

target.name: Local forecast by "City, St" or ZIP code
